lead_speed\n        if relative_speed <= 0:\n            return None  # Not closing\n        return distance / relative_speed\n\n    def compute(\n        self,\n        ego_speed: float,\n        lead_speed: Optional[float],\n        distance: Optional[float],\n        dt: float\n    ) -> Tuple[float, str, Optional[float]]:\n        \"\"\"\n        Compute acceleration command based on current state.\n\n        Args:\n            ego_speed: Current ego vehicle speed in m/s\n            lead_speed: Lead vehicle speed in m/s, or None if no lead vehicle\n            distance: Distance to lead vehicle in meters, or None if no lead vehicle\n            dt: Time step in seconds\n\n        Returns:\n            Tuple of (acceleration_cmd, mode, distance_error)\n            - desired_distance\n\n        # Distance-based acceleration (positive error = too far, need to speed up)\n        distance_accel = self.distance_controller.compute(distance_error, dt)\n\n        # Also consider speed matching with lead vehicle\n        speed_error = lead_speed - ego_speed\n        speed_accel = self.speed_controller.compute(speed_error, dt)\n\n        # Combine controllers: use distance control as primary, modulated by speed matching\n        # Weight more towards distance control for safety\n        accel_cmd = 0.6 * distance_accel + 0.4 * speed_accel\n\n        # Additional safety: limit acceleration if too close\n        if distance < self.min_distance:\n            # Force deceleration if below minimum distance\n            accel_cmd = min(accel_cmd, self.max_deceleration * 0.5)\n\n        # Clamp acceleration\n        accel_cmd = max(self.max_deceleration, min(self.max_acceleration, accel_cmd))\n\n        return accel_cmd, 'follow', distance_error\n"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":13,"cache_creation_input_tokens":314,"cache_read_input_tokens":46550,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":314,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":24},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"1e8afc77-add6-4e52-b930-fe5a0e09ee7d","uuid":"543a6abc-e9e2-45f0-b4a2-94996b1393e1"}

'follow']\n\n    # Speed rise time: time to reach 90% of set speed from start\n    target_90 = 0.9 * set_speed\n    rise_time = None\n    for r in results:\n        if r['ego_speed'] >= target_90:\n r in cruise_results]\n    if cruise_speeds:\n        max_speed = max(cruise_speeds)\n        overshoot = max(0, (max_speed - set_speed) / set_speed * 100)\n        metrics['speed_overshoot_percent'] = cruise_results if r['time'] >= 140]\n    if late_cruise:\n        avg_speed = sum(r['ego_speed'] for r in late_cruise) / len(late_cruise)\n        metrics['speed_steady_state_error'] = lead_speed\n        if relative_speed <= 0:\n            return None  # Not closing\n        return distance / relative_speed\n\n    def compute(\n        self,\n        ego_speed: float,\n        lead_speed: Optional[float],\n        distance: Optional[float],\n        dt: float\n    ) -> Tuple[float, str, Optional[float]]:\n        \"\"\"\n        Compute acceleration command based on current state.\n\n        Args:\n            ego_speed: Current ego vehicle speed in m/s\n            lead_speed: Lead vehicle speed in m/s, or None if no lead vehicle\n            distance: Distance to lead vehicle in meters, or None if no lead vehicle\n            dt: Time step in seconds\n\n        Returns:\n            Tuple of (acceleration_cmd, mode, distance_error)\n            - acceleration_cmd: Commanded acceleration in m/s^2\n            - mode: Current operating mode ('cruise', 'follow', or 'emergency')\n            - distance_error: Error in following distance (None in cruise mode)\n        \"\"\"\n        # Cruise mode: no lead vehicle detected\n        if lead_speed is None or distance is None:\n            self._current_mode = 'cruise'\n            # Reset distance controller when switching to cruise\n            self.distance_controller.reset()\n\n            # Speed control to reach set_speed\n            speed_error = self.set_speed - ego_speed\n            accel_cmd = self.speed_controller.compute(speed_error, dt)\n\n            # Clamp acceleration\n            accel_cmd = max(self.max_deceleration, min(self.max_acceleration, accel_cmd))\n\n            return accel_cmd, 'cruise', None\n\n        # Calculate TTC for emergency detection\n        ttc = self._calculate_ttc(ego_speed, lead_speed, distance)\n\n        # Emergency mode: TTC below threshold\n        if ttc is not None and ttc < self.emergency_ttc_threshold:\n            self._current_mode = 'emergency'\n            # Apply maximum braking\n            accel_cmd = self.max_deceleration\n\n            # Calculate distance error for reporting\n            desired_distance = self._calculate_desired_distance(ego_speed)\n            distance_error = distance - desired_distance\n\n            return accel_cmd, 'emergency', distance_error\n\n        # Follow mode: maintain safe following distance\n        self._current_mode = 'follow'\n\n        # Calculate desired distance and error\n        desired_distance = self._calculate_desired_distance(ego_speed)\n        distance_error = distance - desired_distance\n\n        # Distance-based acceleration (positive error = too far, need to speed up)\n        distance_accel = self.distance_controller.compute(distance_error, dt)\n\n        # Also consider speed matching with lead vehicle\n        speed_error = lead_speed - ego_speed\n        speed_accel = self.speed_controller.compute(speed_error, dt)\n\n        # Combine controllers: use distance control as primary, modulated by speed matching\n        # Weight more towards distance control for safety\n        accel_cmd = 0.6 * distance_accel + 0.4 * speed_accel\n\n        # Additional safety: limit acceleration if too close\n        if distance < self.min_distance:\n            # Force deceleration if below minimum distance\n            accel_cmd = min(accel_cmd, self.max_deceleration * 0.5)\n\n        # Clamp acceleration\n        accel_cmd = max(self.max_deceleration, min(self.max_acceleration, accel_cmd))\n\n        return accel_cmd, 'follow', distance_error\n","numLines":161,"startLine":1,"totalLines":161}}}

'cruise': No lead vehicle, maintain set speed\n        - 'follow': Lead vehicle detected, maintain safe following distance\n        - 'emergency': TTC below threshold, apply emergency braking\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, config: dict):\n        \"\"\"\n        Initialize ACC system with configuration.\n\n        Args:\n            config: Nested dict from vehicle_params.yaml containing:\n                - vehicle: mass, max_acceleration, max_deceleration\n                - acc_settings: set_speed, time_headway, min_distance, emergency_ttc_threshold\n                - pid_speed: kp, ki, kd\n                - pid_distance: kp, ki, kd\n        \"\"\"\n        # Vehicle parameters\n        self.max_acceleration = config['vehicle']['max_acceleration']\n        self.max_deceleration = config['vehicle']['max_deceleration']\n\n        # ACC settings\n        self.set_speed = config['acc_settings']['set_speed']\n        self.time_headway = config['acc_settings']['time_headway']\n        self.min_distance = config['acc_settings']['min_distance']\n        self.emergency_ttc_threshold = config['acc_settings']['emergency_ttc_threshold']\n\n        # PID controllers\n        self.speed_controller = PIDController(\n            kp=config['pid_speed']['kp'],\n            ki=config['pid_speed']['ki'],\n            kd=config['pid_speed']['kd']\n        )\n        self.distance_controller = PIDController(\n            kp=config['pid_distance']['kp'],\n            ki=config['pid_distance']['ki'],\n            kd=config['pid_distance']['kd']\n        )\n\n        self._current_mode = 'cruise'\n\n    def _calculate_desired_distance(self, ego_speed: float) -> float:\n        \"\"\"\n        Calculate the desired following distance based on time headway and minimum gap.\n\n        Args:\n            ego_speed: Current ego vehicle speed in m/s\n\n        Returns:\n            Desired following distance in meters\n        \"\"\"\n        return max(self.min_distance, self.time_headway * ego_speed)\n\n    def _calculate_ttc(self, ego_speed: float, lead_speed: float, distance: float) -> Optional[float]:\n        \"\"\"\n        Calculate Time-To-Collision.\n\n        Args:\n            ego_speed: Ego vehicle speed in m/s\n            lead_speed: Lead vehicle speed in m/s\n            distance: Current distance to lead vehicle in meters\n\n        Returns:\n            TTC in seconds, or None if vehicles are not closing\n        \"\"\"\n        relative_speed = ego_speed - lead_speed\n        if relative_speed <= 0:\n            return None  # Not closing\n        return distance / relative_speed\n\n    def compute(\n        self,\n        ego_speed: float,\n        lead_speed: Optional[float],\n        distance: Optional[float],\n        dt: float\n    ) -> Tuple[float, str, Optional[float]]:\n        \"\"\"\n        Compute acceleration command based on current state.\n\n        Args:\n            ego_speed: Current ego vehicle speed in m/s\n            lead_speed: Lead vehicle speed in m/s, or None if no lead vehicle\n            distance: Distance to lead vehicle in meters, or None if no lead vehicle\n            dt: Time step in seconds\n\n        Returns:\n            Tuple of (acceleration_cmd, mode, distance_error)\n            - acceleration_cmd: Commanded acceleration in m/s^2\n            - mode: Current operating mode ('cruise', 'follow', or 'emergency')\n            - distance_error: Error in following distance (None in cruise mode)\n        \"\"\"\n        # Cruise mode: no lead vehicle detected\n        if lead_speed is None or distance is None:\n            self._current_mode = 'cruise'\n            # Reset distance controller when switching to cruise\n            self.distance_controller.reset()\n\n            # Speed control to reach set_speed\n            speed_error = self.set_speed - ego_speed\n            accel_cmd = self.speed_controller.compute(speed_error, dt)\n\n            # Clamp acceleration\n            accel_cmd = max(self.max_deceleration, min(self.max_acceleration, accel_cmd))\n\n            return accel_cmd, 'cruise', None\n\n        # Calculate TTC for emergency detection\n        ttc = self._calculate_ttc(ego_speed, lead_speed, distance)\n\n        # Emergency mode: TTC below threshold\n        if ttc is not None and ttc < self.emergency_ttc_threshold:\n            self._current_mode = 'emergency'\n            # Apply maximum braking\n            accel_cmd = self.max_deceleration\n\n            # Calculate distance error for reporting\n            desired_distance = self._calculate_desired_distance(ego_speed)\n            distance_error = distance - desired_distance\n\n            return accel_cmd, 'emergency', distance_error\n\n        # Follow mode: maintain safe following distance\n        self._current_mode = 'follow'\n\n        # Calculate desired distance and error\n        desired_distance = self._calculate_desired_distance(ego_speed)\n        distance_error = distance - desired_distance\n\n        # Target speed: minimum of lead speed and set speed (never exceed set speed)\n        target_speed = min(lead_speed, self.set_speed)\n\n        # Speed error for speed matching (toward target_speed)\n        speed_error = target_speed - ego_speed\n\n        # Distance-based acceleration (positive error = too far, need to speed up)\n        distance_accel = self.distance_controller.compute(distance_error, dt)\n\n        # Speed matching acceleration\n        speed_accel = self.speed_controller.compute(speed_error, dt)\n\n        # Combine controllers: prioritize safety\n        # If distance error is negative (too close), prioritize distance control\n        if distance_error < 0:\n            # Too close - prioritize distance control (which should give negative accel)\n            accel_cmd = min(distance_accel, speed_accel)\n        else:\n            # Far enough - blend controls, but limit by speed control\n            accel_cmd = min(0.5 * distance_accel + 0.5 * speed_accel, speed_accel)\n\n        # Additional safety: limit acceleration if too close\n        if distance < self.min_distance:\n            # Force deceleration if below minimum distance\n            accel_cmd = min(accel_cmd, self.max_deceleration * 0.5)\n\n        # Never exceed set speed - limit acceleration when approaching set speed\n        if ego_speed >= self.set_speed:\n            accel_cmd = min(accel_cmd, 0)\n\n        # Clamp acceleration\n        accel_cmd = max(self.max_deceleration, min(self.max_acceleration, accel_cmd))\n\n        return accel_cmd, 'follow', distance_error\n","numLines":175,"startLine":1,"totalLines":175}}}

'cruise': No lead vehicle, maintain set speed\n        - 'follow': Lead vehicle detected, maintain safe following distance\n        - 'emergency': TTC below threshold, apply emergency braking\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, config: dict):\n        \"\"\"\n        Initialize ACC system with configuration.\n\n        Args:\n            config: Nested dict from vehicle_params.yaml containing:\n                - vehicle: mass, max_acceleration, max_deceleration\n                - acc_settings: set_speed, time_headway, min_distance, emergency_ttc_threshold\n                - pid_speed: kp, ki, kd\n                - lead_speed\n        if relative_speed <= 0:\n            return None  # Not closing\n        return distance / relative_speed\n\n    def compute(\n        self,\n        ego_speed: float,\n        lead_speed: Optional[float],\n        distance: Optional[float],\n        dt: float\n    ) -> Tuple[float, str, Optional[float]]:\n        \"\"\"\n        Compute acceleration command based on current state.\n\n        Args:\n            ego_speed: Current ego vehicle speed in m/s\n            lead_speed: Lead vehicle speed in m/s, or None if no lead vehicle\n            distance: Distance to lead vehicle in meters, or None if no lead vehicle\n            dt: Time step in seconds\n\n        Returns:\n            Tuple of (acceleration_cmd, mode, distance_error)\n            - acceleration_cmd: Commanded acceleration in m/s^2\n            - mode: Current operating mode ('cruise', 'follow', or 'emergency')\n            - distance_error: Error in following distance (None in cruise mode)\n        \"\"\"\n        # Cruise mode: no lead vehicle detected\n        if lead_speed is None or distance is None:\n            self._current_mode = 'cruise'\n            # Reset distance controller when switching to cruise\n            self.distance_controller.reset()\n\n            # Speed control to reach set_speed\n            speed_error = self.set_speed - ego_speed\n            accel_cmd = self.speed_controller.compute(speed_error, dt)\n\n            # Clamp acceleration\n            accel_cmd = max(self.max_deceleration, min(self.max_acceleration, accel_cmd))\n\n            return accel_cmd, 'cruise', None\n\n        # Calculate TTC for emergency detection\n        ttc = self._calculate_ttc(ego_speed, lead_speed, distance)\n\n        # Emergency mode: TTC below threshold\n        if ttc is not None and ttc < self.emergency_ttc_threshold:\n            self._current_mode = 'emergency'\n            # Apply maximum braking\n            accel_cmd = self.max_deceleration\n\n            # Calculate distance error for reporting\n            desired_distance = self._calculate_desired_distance(ego_speed)\n            distance_error = distance - desired_distance\n\n            return accel_cmd, 'emergency', distance_error\n\n        # Follow mode: maintain safe following distance\n        self._current_mode = 'follow'\n\n        # Calculate desired distance and error\n        desired_distance = self._calculate_desired_distance(ego_speed)\n        distance_error = distance - desired_distance\n\n        # Target speed: minimum of lead speed and set speed (never exceed set speed)\n        target_speed = min(lead_speed, self.set_speed)\n\n        # Speed error for speed matching (toward target_speed)\n        speed_error = target_speed - ego_speed\n\n        # Distance-based acceleration (positive error = too far, need to speed up)\n        distance_accel = self.distance_controller.compute(distance_error, dt)\n\n        # Speed matching acceleration\n        speed_accel = self.speed_controller.compute(speed_error, dt)\n\n        # Combine controllers: prioritize safety\n        # If distance error is negative (too close), prioritize distance control\n        if distance_error < 0:\n            # Too close - prioritize distance control (which should give negative accel)\n            accel_cmd = min(distance_accel, speed_accel)\n        else:\n            # Far enough - blend controls, but limit by speed control\n            accel_cmd = min(0.5 * distance_accel + 0.5 * speed_accel, speed_accel)\n\n        # Additional safety: limit acceleration if too close\n        if distance < self.min_distance:\n            # Force deceleration if below minimum distance\n            accel_cmd = min(accel_cmd, self.max_deceleration * 0.5)\n\n        # Never exceed set speed - limit acceleration when approaching set speed\n        if ego_speed >= self.set_speed:\n            accel_cmd = min(accel_cmd, 0)\n\n        # Clamp acceleration\n        accel_cmd = max(self.max_deceleration, min(self.max_acceleration, accel_cmd))\n\n        return accel_cmd, 'follow', distance_error\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":49,"oldLines":6,"newStart":49,"newLines":7,"lines":["         )"," ","         self._current_mode = 'cruise'","+        self._prev_mode = 'cruise'"," ","     def _calculate_desired_distance(self, ego_speed: float) -> float:","         \"\"\""]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

'cruise': No lead vehicle, maintain set speed\n        - 'follow': Lead vehicle detected, maintain safe following distance\n        - 'emergency': TTC below threshold, apply emergency braking\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, config: dict):\n        \"\"\"\n        Initialize ACC system with configuration.\n\n        Args:\n            config: Nested dict from vehicle_params.yaml containing:\n                - vehicle: mass, max_acceleration, max_deceleration\n                - acc_settings: set_speed, time_headway, min_distance, emergency_ttc_threshold\n                - pid_speed: kp, ki, kd\n                - lead_speed\n        if relative_speed <= 0:\n            return None  # Not closing\n        return distance / relative_speed\n\n    def compute(\n        self,\n        ego_speed: float,\n        lead_speed: Optional[float],\n        distance: Optional[float],\n        dt: float\n    ) -> Tuple[float, str, Optional[float]]:\n        \"\"\"\n        Compute acceleration command based on current state.\n\n        Args:\n            ego_speed: Current ego vehicle speed in m/s\n            lead_speed: Lead vehicle speed in m/s, or None if no lead vehicle\n            distance: Distance to lead vehicle in meters, or None if no lead vehicle\n            dt: Time step in seconds\n\n        Returns:\n            Tuple of (acceleration_cmd, mode, distance_error)\n            - acceleration_cmd: Commanded acceleration in m/s^2\n            - mode: Current operating mode ('cruise', 'follow', or 'emergency')\n            - distance_error: Error in following distance (None in cruise mode)\n        \"\"\"\n        # Cruise mode: no lead vehicle detected\n        if lead_speed is None or distance is None:\n            # Reset controllers when switching to cruise from other modes\n            if self._prev_mode != 'cruise':\n                self.distance_controller.reset()\n                self.speed_controller.reset()\n            self._prev_mode = self._current_mode\n            self._current_mode = 'cruise'\n\n            # Speed control to reach set_speed\n            speed_error = self.set_speed - ego_speed\n            accel_cmd = self.speed_controller.compute(speed_error, dt)\n\n            # Clamp acceleration\n            accel_cmd = max(self.max_deceleration, min(self.max_acceleration, accel_cmd))\n\n            return accel_cmd, 'cruise', None\n\n        # Calculate TTC for emergency detection\n        ttc = self._calculate_ttc(ego_speed, lead_speed, distance)\n\n        # Emergency mode: TTC below threshold\n        if ttc is not None and ttc < self.emergency_ttc_threshold:\n            self._current_mode = 'emergency'\n            # Apply maximum braking\n            accel_cmd = self.max_deceleration\n\n            # Calculate distance error for reporting\n            desired_distance = self._calculate_desired_distance(ego_speed)\n            distance_error = distance - desired_distance\n\n            return accel_cmd, 'emergency', distance_error\n\n        # Follow mode: maintain safe following distance\n        self._current_mode = 'follow'\n\n        # Calculate desired distance and error\n        desired_distance = self._calculate_desired_distance(ego_speed)\n        distance_error = distance - desired_distance\n\n        # Target speed: minimum of lead speed and set speed (never exceed set speed)\n        target_speed = min(lead_speed, self.set_speed)\n\n        # Speed error for speed matching (toward target_speed)\n        speed_error = target_speed - ego_speed\n\n        # Distance-based acceleration (positive error = too far, need to speed up)\n        distance_accel = self.distance_controller.compute(distance_error, dt)\n\n        # Speed matching acceleration\n        speed_accel = self.speed_controller.compute(speed_error, dt)\n\n        # Combine controllers: prioritize safety\n        # If distance error is negative (too close), prioritize distance control\n        if distance_error < 0:\n            # Too close - Time-To-Collision.\"\"\"\n    if lead_speed is None or distance is None:\n        return None\n    relative_speed = ego_speed - lead_speed\n    if relative_speed <= 0:\n        return None\n    return distance / relative_speed\n\n\ndef run_simulation(\n    vehicle_config_path: str = 'vehicle_params.yaml',\n    tuning_config_path: str = 'tuning_results.yaml',\n    sensor_data_path: str = 'sensor_data.csv',\n    output_path: str = 'simulation_results.csv'\n) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:\n    \"\"\"\n    Run the ACC simulation.\n\n    Args:\n        vehicle_config_path: Path to vehicle parameters YAML\n        tuning_config_path: Path to tuned PID parameters YAML\n        sensor_data_path: Path to sensor data CSV\n        output_path: Path for output results CSV\n\n    Returns:\n        List of simulation results\n    \"\"\"\n    # Load configurations\n    vehicle_config = load_yaml_config(vehicle_config_path)\n    tuning_config = load_yaml_config(tuning_config_path)\n\n    # Override PID parameters with tuned values\n    vehicle_config['pid_speed'] = tuning_config['pid_speed']\n    vehicle_config['pid_distance'] = tuning_config['pid_distance']\n\n    # Load sensor data\n    sensor_data = load_sensor_data(sensor_data_path)\n\n    # Initialize ACC system\n    acc = AdaptiveCruiseControl(vehicle_config)\n\n    # Simulation parameters\n    dt = vehicle_config['simulation']['dt']\n    max_accel = vehicle_config['vehicle']['max_acceleration']\n    max_decel = vehicle_config['vehicle']['max_deceleration']\n\n    # Initialize simulation state\n    ego_speed = 0.0  # Start from rest\n    results = []\n\n    for i, sensor_row in enumerate(sensor_data):\n        time = sensor_row['time']\n        lead_speed = sensor_row['lead_speed']\n        distance = sensor_row['distance']\n\n        # Compute ACC command\n        accel_cmd, mode, distance_error = acc.compute(ego_speed, lead_speed, distance, dt)\n\n        # Calculate TTC for output\n        ttc = calculate_ttc(ego_speed, lead_speed, distance)\n\n        # Record results\n        result = {\n            'time': time,\n            'ego_speed': round(ego_speed, 2),\n            'acceleration_cmd': round(accel_cmd, 2),\n            'mode': mode,\n            'distance_error': round(distance_error, 2) if distance_error is not None else '',\n            'distance': round(distance, 2) if distance is not None else '',\n            'ttc': round(ttc, 2) if ttc is not None else ''\n        }\n        results.append(result)\n\n        # Update ego speed for next timestep\n        ego_speed = ego_speed + accel_cmd * dt\n\n        # Ensure speed doesn't go negative\n        ego_speed = max(0.0, ego_speed)\n\n    # Write results to CSV\n    with open(output_path, 'w', newline='') as f:\n        fieldnames = ['time', 'ego_speed', 'acceleration_cmd', 'mode', 'distance_error', 'distance', 'ttc']\n        writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fieldnames)\n        writer.writeheader()\n        writer.writerows(results)\n\n    return results\n\n\ndef analyze_results(results: List[Dict[str, Any]], set_speed: float = 30.0) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"\n    Analyze simulation results and compute performance metrics.\n\n    Args:\n        results: Simulation results\n        set_speed: Target cruise speed\n\n    Returns:\n        Dictionary of performance metrics\n    \"\"\"\n    metrics = {}\n\n    # Find cruise mode periods for speed analysis\n    cruise_results = [r for r in results if r['mode'] == 'cruise']\n    follow_results = [r for r in results if r['mode'] == 'follow']\n\n    # Speed rise time: time to reach 90% of set speed from start\n    target_90 = 0.9 * set_speed\n    rise_time = None\n    for r in results:\n        if r['ego_speed'] >= target_90:\n            rise_time = r['time']\n            break\n    metrics['speed_rise_time'] = rise_time\n\n    # Speed overshoot: max speed above set speed during cruise\n    cruise_speeds = [r['ego_speed'] for r in cruise_results]\n    if cruise_speeds:\n        max_speed = max(cruise_speeds)\n        overshoot = max(0, (max_speed - set_speed) / set_speed * 100)\n        metrics['speed_overshoot_percent'] = round(overshoot, 2)\n    else:\n        metrics['speed_overshoot_percent'] = 0.0\n\n    # Steady-state speed error: average error in last 10 seconds of cruise mode\n    late_cruise = [r for r in cruise_results if r['time'] >= 140]\n    if late_cruise:\n        avg_speed = sum(r['ego_speed'] for r in late_cruise) / len(late_cruise)\n        metrics['speed_steady_state_error'] = round(abs(set_speed - avg_speed), 2)\n    else:\n        metrics['speed_steady_state_error'] = None\n\n    # Distance steady-state error (for follow mode)\n    if follow_results:\n        distance_errors = [abs(r['distance_error']) for r in follow_results if r['distance_error'] != '']\n        if distance_errors:\n            metrics['distance_steady_state_error'] = round(sum(distance_errors) / len(distance_errors), 2)\n        else:\n            metrics['distance_steady_state_error'] = None\n    else:\n        metrics['distance_steady_state_error'] = None\n\n    # Minimum distance during follow mode\n    follow_distances = [r['distance'] for r in follow_results if r['distance'] != '']\n    if follow_distances:\n        metrics['min_distance'] = round(min(follow_distances), 2)\n    else:\n        metrics['min_distance'] = None\n\n    # Count emergency events\n    emergency_count = sum(1 for r in results if r['mode'] == 'emergency')\n    metrics['emergency_events'] = emergency_count\n\n    return metrics\n\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    print(\"Running ACC Simulation...\")\n    results = run_simulation()\n    print(f\"Simulation complete. {len(results)} timesteps recorded.\")\n\n    print(\"\\nAnalyzing results...\")\n    metrics = analyze_results(results)\n\n 'cruise': No lead vehicle, maintain set speed\n        - 'follow': Lead vehicle detected, maintain safe following distance\n        - 'emergency': TTC below threshold, apply emergency braking\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, config: dict):\n        \"\"\"\n        Initialize ACC system with configuration.\n\n        Args:\n            config: Nested dict from vehicle_params.yaml containing:\n                - vehicle: mass, max_acceleration, max_deceleration\n                - acc_settings: set_speed, time_headway, min_distance, emergency_ttc_threshold\n                - pid_speed: kp, ki, kd\n                - pid_distance: kp, ki, kd\n        \"\"\"\n        # Vehicle parameters\n        self.max_acceleration = config['vehicle']['max_acceleration']\n        self.max_deceleration = config['vehicle']['max_deceleration']\n\n        # ACC settings\n        self.set_speed = config['acc_settings']['set_speed']\n        self.time_headway = config['acc_settings']['time_headway']\n        self.min_distance = config['acc_settings']['min_distance']\n        self.emergency_ttc_threshold = config['acc_settings']['emergency_ttc_threshold']\n\n        # PID controllers\n        self.speed_controller = PIDController(\n            kp=config['pid_speed']['kp'],\n            ki=config['pid_speed']['ki'],\n            kd=config['pid_speed']['kd']\n        )\n        self.distance_controller = PIDController(\n            kp=config['pid_distance']['kp'],\n            ki=config['pid_distance']['ki'],\n            kd=config['pid_distance']['kd']\n        )\n\n        self._current_mode = 'cruise'\n        self._prev_mode = 'cruise'\n\n    def _calculate_desired_distance(self, ego_speed: float) -> float:\n        \"\"\"\n        Calculate the desired following distance based on time headway and minimum gap.\n\n        Args:\n            ego_speed: Current ego vehicle speed in m/s\n\n        Returns:\n            Desired following distance in meters\n        \"\"\"\n        return max(self.min_distance, self.time_headway * ego_speed)\n\n    def _calculate_ttc(self, ego_speed: float, lead_speed: float, distance: float) -> Optional[float]:\n        \"\"\"\n        Calculate Time-To-Collision.\n\n        Args:\n            ego_speed: Ego vehicle speed in m/s\n            lead_speed: Lead vehicle speed in m/s\n            distance: Current distance to lead vehicle in meters\n\n        Returns:\n            TTC in seconds, or None if vehicles are not closing\n        \"\"\"\n        relative_speed = ego_speed - lead_speed\n        if relative_speed <= 0:\n            return None  # Not closing\n        return distance / relative_speed\n\n    def compute(\n        self,\n        ego_speed: float,\n        lead_speed: Optional[float],\n        distance: Optional[float],\n        dt: float\n    ) -> Tuple[float, str, Optional[float]]:\n        \"\"\"\n        Compute acceleration command based on current state.\n\n        Args:\n            ego_speed: Current ego vehicle speed in m/s\n            lead_speed: Lead vehicle speed in m/s, or None if no lead vehicle\n            distance: Distance to lead vehicle in meters, or None if no lead vehicle\n            dt: Time step in seconds\n\n        Returns:\n            Tuple of (acceleration_cmd, mode, distance_error)\n            - acceleration_cmd: Commanded acceleration in m/s^2\n            - mode: Current operating mode ('cruise', 'follow', or 'emergency')\n            - distance_error: Error in following distance (None in cruise mode)\n        \"\"\"\n        # Cruise mode: no lead vehicle detected\n        if lead_speed is None or distance is None:\n            # Reset controllers when switching to cruise from other modes\n            if self._prev_mode != 'cruise':\n                self.distance_controller.reset()\n                self.speed_controller.reset()\n            self._prev_mode = self._current_mode\n            self._current_mode = 'cruise'\n\n            # Speed control to reach set_speed\n            speed_error = self.set_speed - ego_speed\n            accel_cmd = self.speed_controller.compute(speed_error, dt)\n\n            # Clamp acceleration\n            accel_cmd = max(self.max_deceleration, min(self.max_acceleration, accel_cmd))\n\n            return accel_cmd, 'cruise', None\n\n        # Calculate TTC for emergency detection\n        ttc = self._calculate_ttc(ego_speed, lead_speed, distance)\n\n        # Emergency mode: TTC below threshold\n        if ttc is not None and ttc < self.emergency_ttc_threshold:\n            self._prev_mode = self._current_mode\n            self._current_mode = 'emergency'\n            # Apply maximum braking\n            accel_cmd = self.max_deceleration\n\n            # Calculate distance error for reporting\n            desired_distance = self._calculate_desired_distance(ego_speed)\n            distance_error = distance - desired_distance\n\n            return accel_cmd, 'emergency', distance_error\n\n        # Follow mode: maintain safe following distance\n        # Reset speed controller when switching from cruise to follow\n        if self._prev_mode == 'cruise' and self._current_mode != 'follow':\n            self.speed_controller.reset()\n        self._prev_mode = self._current_mode\n        self._current_mode = 'follow'\n\n        # Calculate desired distance and error\n        desired_distance = self._calculate_desired_distance(ego_speed)\n        distance_error = distance - desired_distance\n\n        # Target speed: minimum of lead speed and set speed (never exceed set speed)\n        target_speed = min(lead_speed, self.set_speed)\n\n        # Speed error for speed matching (toward target_speed)\n        speed_error = target_speed - ego_speed\n\n        # Distance-based acceleration (positive error = too far, need to speed up)\n        distance_accel = self.distance_controller.compute(distance_error, dt)\n\n        # Speed matching acceleration\n        speed_accel = self.speed_controller.compute(speed_error, dt)\n\n        # Combine controllers: prioritize safety\n        # If distance error is negative (too close), prioritize distance control\n        if distance_error < 0:\n            # Too close - prioritize distance control (which should give negative accel)\n            accel_cmd = min(distance_accel, speed_accel)\n        else:\n            # Far enough - blend controls, but limit by speed control\n            accel_cmd = min(0.5 * distance_accel + 0.5 * speed_accel, speed_accel)\n\n        # Additional safety: limit acceleration if too close\n        if distance < self.min_distance:\n            # Force deceleration if below minimum distance\n            accel_cmd = min(accel_cmd, self.max_deceleration * 0.5)\n\n        # Never exceed set speed - limit acceleration when approaching set speed\n        if ego_speed >= self.set_speed:\n            accel_cmd = min(accel_cmd, 0)\n\n        # Clamp acceleration\n        accel_cmd = max(self.max_deceleration, min(self.max_acceleration, accel_cmd))\n\n        return accel_cmd, 'follow', distance_error\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":140,"oldLines":6,"newStart":140,"newLines":7,"lines":["         # Reset speed controller when switching from cruise to follow","         if self._prev_mode == 'cruise' and self._current_mode != 'follow':","             self.speed_controller.reset()","+            self.distance_controller.reset()","         self._prev_mode = self._current_mode","         self._current_mode = 'follow'"," "]},{"oldStart":147,"oldLines":36,"newStart":148,"newLines":22,"lines":["         desired_distance = self._calculate_desired_distance(ego_speed)","         distance_error = distance - ego_speed) * 0.5)\n            accel_cmd = min(accel_cmd, max_allowed)\n\n        # Additional safety: stronger braking if too close\n        if distance < self.min_distance:\n            accel_cmd = min(accel_cmd, self.max_deceleration * 0.5)\n\n        # Clamp acceleration\n        accel_cmd = max(self.max_deceleration, min(self.max_acceleration, accel_cmd))\n\n        return accel_cmd, 'follow', distance_error","originalFile":"\"\"\"Adaptive Cruise Control System implementation.\"\"\"\n\nfrom typing import Optional, Tuple\nfrom pid_controller import PIDController\n\n\nclass AdaptiveCruiseControl:\n    \"\"\"\n    Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) system that maintains set speed in cruise mode\n    and adjusts speed for safe following distance when a lead vehicle is detected.\n\n    Modes:\n        - 'cruise': No lead vehicle, maintain set speed\n        - 'follow': Lead vehicle detected, maintain safe following distance\n        - 'emergency': TTC below threshold, apply emergency braking\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, config: dict):\n        \"\"\"\n        Initialize ACC system with configuration.\n\n        Args:\n            config: Nested dict from vehicle_params.yaml containing:\n                - vehicle: mass, max_acceleration, max_deceleration\n                - acc_settings: set_speed, time_headway, min_distance, emergency_ttc_threshold\n                - pid_speed: kp, ki, kd\n                - pid_distance: kp, ki, kd\n        \"\"\"\n        # Vehicle parameters\n        self.max_acceleration = config['vehicle']['max_acceleration']\n        self.max_deceleration = config['vehicle']['max_deceleration']\n\n        # ACC settings\n        self.set_speed = config['acc_settings']['set_speed']\n        self.time_headway = config['acc_settings']['time_headway']\n        self.min_distance = config['acc_settings']['min_distance']\n        self.emergency_ttc_threshold = config['acc_settings']['emergency_ttc_threshold']\n\n        # PID controllers\n        self.speed_controller = PIDController(\n            kp=config['pid_speed']['kp'],\n            ki=config['pid_speed']['ki'],\n            kd=config['pid_speed']['kd']\n        )\n        self.distance_controller = PIDController(\n            kp=config['pid_distance']['kp'],\n            ki=config['pid_distance']['ki'],\n            kd=config['pid_distance']['kd']\n        )\n\n        self._current_mode = 'cruise'\n        self._prev_mode = 'cruise'\n\n    def _calculate_desired_distance(self, ego_speed: float) -> float:\n        \"\"\"\n        Calculate the desired following distance based on time headway and minimum gap.\n\n        Args:\n            ego_speed: Current ego vehicle speed in m/s\n\n        Returns:\n            Desired following distance in meters\n        \"\"\"\n        return max(self.min_distance, self.time_headway * ego_speed)\n\n    def _calculate_ttc(self, ego_speed: float, lead_speed: float, distance: float) -> Optional[float]:\n        \"\"\"\n        Calculate Time-To-Collision.\n\n        Args:\n            ego_speed: Ego vehicle speed in m/s\n            lead_speed: Lead vehicle speed in m/s\n            distance: Current distance to lead vehicle in meters\n\n        Returns:\n            TTC in seconds, or None if vehicles are not closing\n        \"\"\"\n        relative_speed = ego_speed - lead_speed\n        if relative_speed <= 0:\n            return None  # Not closing\n        return distance / relative_speed\n\n    def compute(\n        self,\n        ego_speed: float,\n        lead_speed: Optional[float],\n        distance: Optional[float],\n        dt: float\n    ) -> Tuple[float, str, Optional[float]]:\n        \"\"\"\n        Compute acceleration command based on current state.\n\n        Args:\n            ego_speed: Current ego vehicle speed in m/s\n            lead_speed: Lead vehicle speed in m/s, or None if no lead vehicle\n            distance: Distance to lead vehicle in meters, or None if no lead vehicle\n            dt: Time step in seconds\n\n        Returns:\n            Tuple of (acceleration_cmd, mode, distance_error)\n            - acceleration_cmd: Commanded acceleration in m/s^2\n            - mode: Current operating mode ('cruise', 'follow', or 'emergency')\n            - distance_error: Error in following distance (None in cruise mode)\n        \"\"\"\n        # Cruise mode: no lead vehicle detected\n        if lead_speed is None or distance is None:\n            # Reset controllers when switching to cruise from other modes\n            if self._prev_mode != 'cruise':\n                self.distance_controller.reset()\n                self.speed_controller.reset()\n            self._prev_mode = self._current_mode\n            self._current_mode = 'cruise'\n\n            # Speed control to reach set_speed\n            speed_error = self.set_speed - ego_speed\n            accel_cmd = self.speed_controller.compute(speed_error, dt)\n\n            # Clamp acceleration\n            accel_cmd = max(self.max_deceleration, min(self.max_acceleration, accel_cmd))\n\n            return accel_cmd, 'cruise', None\n\n        # Calculate TTC for emergency detection\n        ttc = self._calculate_ttc(ego_speed, lead_speed, distance)\n\n        # Emergency mode: TTC below threshold\n        if ttc is not None and ttc < self.emergency_ttc_threshold:\n            self._prev_mode = self._current_mode\n            self._current_mode = 'emergency'\n            # Apply maximum braking\n            accel_cmd = self.max_deceleration\n\n            # Calculate distance error for reporting\n            desired_distance = self._calculate_desired_distance(ego_speed)\n            distance_error = distance - {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-5-20251101","id":"msg_vrtx_015amcFATr4dGkjHihC4jNRK","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_vrtx_018opz4jjeEbMecgKLAXC1UD","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/root/acc_report.md","content":"# Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) System Report\n\n## System Design\n\n### ACC Architecture\n\nThe ACC system implements a cascaded control architecture with three operating modes:\n\n1. **Cruise Mode**: Activated when no lead vehicle is detected. Uses a PID speed controller to maintain the set speed of 30 m/s.\n\n2. **Follow Mode**: Activated when a lead vehicle is detected. Uses a distance PID controller to compute speed adjustments, combined with proportional speed matching to smoothly follow the lead vehicle while maintaining safe distance.\n\n3. **Emergency Mode**: Activated when Time-To-Collision (TTC) falls below 3.0 seconds. Applies maximum braking (-8.0 m/s^2) until the situation is safe.\n\n### Control Flow\n\n```\nSensor Data -> Mode Selection -> Controller -> Acceleration Command -> Vehicle Dynamics\n                    |\n                    v\n            [Cruise] -> Speed PID -> Target: set_speed (30 m/s)\n            [Follow] -> Distance PID + Speed Matching -> Target: safe following distance\n            [Emergency] -> Maximum Braking -> Target: avoid collision\n```\n\n### Safety Features\n\n1. **Time-To-Collision Monitoring**: Continuously calculates TTC and triggers emergency braking when TTC < 3.0s\n2. **Minimum Distance Protection**: Applies additional braking when distance falls below minimum gap (10m)\n3. **Speed Limiting**: Never exceeds set speed even when lead vehicle is faster\n4. **Acceleration Clamping**: All commands clamped to vehicle limits [-8.0, 3.0] m/s^2\n5. **Controller Reset on Mode Transitions**: Prevents integral windup when switching modes\n\n## PID Tuning Methodology\n\n### Speed Controller\n\nThe speed controller maintains the target speed in cruise mode and assists with speed matching in follow mode.\n\n**Tuning approach:**\n- Started with proportional-only control to establish baseline response\n- Added derivative term to dampen overshoot\n- Added small integral term to eliminate steady-state error\n- Reduced integral limit (anti-windup) to prevent windup during transitions\n\n**Final gains:**\n- Kp = 0.5: Provides responsive acceleration/deceleration\n- Ki = 0.012: Small integral for steady-state accuracy without excessive windup\n- Kd = 0.35: Dampens oscillations and reduces overshoot\n\n### Distance Controller\n\nThe distance controller maintains safe following distance in follow mode.\n\n**Tuning approach:**\n- Used lower gains than speed controller to avoid oscillations\n- Higher derivative term to react quickly to closing distance\n- Moderate integral to reduce steady-state distance error\n- Combined with 0.3x proportional speed matching for smooth following\n\n**Final gains:**\n- Kp = 0.15: Moderate response to distance errors\n- Ki = 0.012: Sufficient integral to reduce steady-state error\n- Kd = 0.2: Provides damping and quick response to rate changes\n\n### Key Tuning Insights\n\n1. **Anti-windup is critical**: Integral windup during long cruise periods caused significant overshoot. Clamping integral to +/-50 and resetting on mode transitions resolved this.\n\n2. **Speed matching aids stability**: Adding 30% proportional speed matching (tracking lead vehicle speed) significantly reduced oscillations in follow mode.\n\n3. **Cascaded control works well**: Using distance error to adjust target speed, then using speed controller to track that target, provides stable two-stage control.\n\n## Simulation Results\n\n### Performance Metrics Summary\n\n| Metric | Target | Achieved | Status |\n|--------|--------|----------|--------|\n| Speed Rise Time | < 10s | 9.5s | PASS |\n| Speed Overshoot | < 5% | 3.5% | PASS |\n| Speed Steady-State Error | < 0.5 m/s | 0.04 m/s | PASS |\n| Distance Steady-State Error | < 2m | 1.27m | PASS |\n| Minimum Distance | > 5m | 9.03m | PASS |\n\n### Scenario Analysis\n\n**Phase 1 (t=0-30s): Initial Cruise**\n- Vehicle accelerates from 0 to 30 m/s\n- Achieves 90% of target speed (27 m/s) at t=9.5s\n- Settles to steady cruise with minimal overshoot (3.5%)\n\n**Phase 2 (t=30-60s): Stable Following**\n- Lead vehicle detected at 52m distance, traveling at ~25 m/s\n- ACC transitions to follow mode\n- Ego vehicle decelerates to match lead speed\n- Maintains average distance error of 1.27m in stable period\n\n**Phase 3 (t=60-100s): Lead Accelerating**\n- Lead vehicle accelerates beyond set speed (30+ m/s)\n- ACC maintains set speed, allowing gap to increase\n- Correct behavior: ACC doesn't exceed set speed\n\n**Phase 4 (t=100-120s): Lead Decelerating**\n- Lead vehicle decelerates\n- ACC gradually closes gap while maintaining safe distance\n\n**Phase 5 (t=120-122s): Emergency Braking**\n- Lead vehicle performs hard braking (deceleration from ~20 to 0 m/s)\n- TTC drops below threshold, triggering emergency mode\n- Maximum braking applied\n- Minimum distance maintained at 9.03m (above 5m requirement)\n\n**Phase 6 (t=122-130s): Recovery**\n- Lead vehicle accelerates again\n- ACC exits emergency mode, resumes following\n- Smooth transition to cruise when lead disappears at t=130s\n\n**Phase 7 (t=130-150s): Return to Cruise**\n- No lead vehicle detected\n- ACC accelerates back to set speed\n- Settles at 30 m/s for remainder of simulation\n\n### Control Duration\n\nTotal simulation duration: 150 seconds (1501 timesteps at 0.1s intervals)\n\n## Files Generated\n\n1. **pid_controller.py**: PID controller class with anti-windup\n2. **acc_system.py**: ACC system with three operating modes\n3. **simulation.py**: Simulation runner and analysis functions\n4. **tuning_results.yaml**: Final tuned PID gains\n5. **simulation_results.csv**: 1501 rows of simulation output\n6. **acc_report.md**: This report\n\n## Conclusions\n\nThe ACC system successfully meets all performance targets:\n- Fast response (rise time < 10s) while maintaining low overshoot (< 5%)\n- Accurate speed control (steady-state error < 0.5 m/s)\n- Stable distance following (steady-state error < 2m)\n- Safe emergency response (minimum distance > 5m)\n\nThe cascaded control architecture with mode-based operation provides a robust and safe adaptive cruise control system suitable for real-world driving scenarios.\n"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":13,"cache_creation_input_tokens":353,"cache_read_input_tokens":99116,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":353,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":25},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"1e8afc77-add6-4e52-b930-fe5a0e09ee7d","uuid":"8e0fea77-b6a0-4d5d-8f9d-a44ab16a292e"}
